name: 3C 65 (Hubble)
blurb: 3C 65, a radio galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: 3c65-hubble
story: 3C 65 is a distant radio galaxy, shining from an era when massive elliptical galaxies were still assembling. Hubble surveyed it to watch how such giant galaxies, and the crowds around them, took shape.

claims.text: 3C 65 is a radio galaxy at redshift 1.176, a target of Hubble program 16281
Hubble program 16281 surveys high-redshift 3CR radio sources from an era when massive elliptical galaxies were assembling
The program studies the formation of massive galaxies and their cluster environments
